dedupe_keys.name: mv lv transformer station load measurements slovenian pilot site network stream project 2025

description: This STREAM project release provides active-power and reactive-power measurements from 20/0.4-kV transformer stations in the Ajdovščina distribution network in western Slovenia. Janez Gregor Golja at the University of Ljubljana supplies separate CSV files for P and Q. The description states coverage of 2025 at fifteen-minute intervals, with UTC timestamps and anonymised transformer identifiers. Zenodo published the files in June 2026 under CC BY 4.0, with free public access. Station count, missing-data rates and measurement accuracy are not documented in the public description. The series can calibrate transformer loading, reactive-power and local network-capacity simulations. A companion deposit, linked here, gives equipment ratings, impedance parameters and losses using corresponding identifiers. No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this measurement release. The files were not downloaded, so interval completeness and the identifier join remain unchecked.
